basic_profile.bio: An enthusiastic learner from Portland, Oregon, diving into the world of tufting and DIY crafts. During weekdays, I work as a graphic designer, which allows me to explore creativity both digitally and tangibly. I spend my evenings experimenting with new crafting techniques, usually logging onto Reddit between 8 PM and 11 PM. I’m single and enjoy spending weekends exploring the outdoors or binge-watching the latest fantasy series.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: A self-taught creative, my knowledge stems from a mix of online courses, YouTube tutorials, and community workshops. While I have a formal education in graphic design, my passion for tufting and other crafts is fueled by personal projects and online communities.
